replies.title: [Bug] Switching model in the composer keeps the previous thinking level instead of the model's own default
replies.author: btriapitsyn
replies.excerpt: Fixed in 7d037b07d. The thinking level now stays with the model it was set for. Switching models drops it, and the new model starts on its own level: whatever you picked for it earlier in the session…

replies.title: [Bug] Browser captures export at CSS pixel size (1x), so they are half the screen's resolution on a 200% display
replies.author: yulia-ivashko
replies.excerpt: We couldn't reproduce this. On Windows 11 at 150% scaling, a Desktop (1440×900) capture came out at 2160×1350 on both current main and 2.3.0, and with the display forced to 200% it came out at 2880×1…

en.headline: 13 commits across three repos with AI visibility fixes and a new discussion
en.summary: The user made **13 own commits** across three repositories. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` (7 commits), they implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list/inspect/disable/enable capabilities and acceptance tests, revised the specification, and moved plans to `.openchamber/plans`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` (5 own commits plus 25 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`), they fixed AI issue-notifier failure visibility, added model annotations, overhauled the 30-day summary, prevented duplicate issue creation, and refined site typography. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` (1 commit), they added an `opencode-provider` knowledge category. The user commented on `openchamber/openchamber` issue #4939 and started discussion #5114 proposing to split the selection-menu fix. Two replies arrived: `btriapitsyn` confirmed a fix for #4601, and `yulia-ivashko` reported #4899 could not be reproduced. Three issues (#4896, #4920, #4601) were closed by `btriapitsyn`.

zh.headline: 13 次提交跨三个仓库，修复 AI 可见性问题并发起新讨论
zh.summary: 用户当日提交了 **13 次自有提交**，分布在三个仓库。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`（7 次提交），实现了 `skill_management` 插件及 list/inspect/disable/enable 验收测试，修订规范并将计划迁移至 `.openchamber/plans`。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`（5 次自有提交，另有 25 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交），修复了 AI issue notifier 失败可见性，新增模型标注并改版 30 天总结，防止常住 issue 重复创建，优化站点字体。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`（1 次提交），新增 `opencode-provider` 知识类别。用户评论了 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 #4939 并发起讨论 #5114，建议拆分选区菜单修复。收到两条回复：`btriapitsyn` 确认 #4601 已修复，`yulia-ivashko` 表示无法复现 #4899。#4896、#4920、#4601 三个 issue 由 `btriapitsyn` 关闭。
